name: zhihu/search
description: Search Zhihu by keyword with optional result-type, sort, time-interval, topic-display, and offset controls. Use it to find relevant answers, articles, or videos.
readme:
# Zhihu Keyword Search API Returns Zhihu search results for a keyword. Each result in `data` can be a major or topic card with nested discussion items such as questions and answers. The only required input is `keyword`. ## Use cases - Find popular Zhihu discussions about a topic such as `人工智能` for content research. - Collect question titles and answer text on a subject to study what people ask about it. - Track how a topic is discussed over time by filtering with `timeInterval` and sorting by `created_time`. - Pull answer counts and comment counts to rank which questions draw the most engagement. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/search" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "人工智能"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search keywords. | | `offset` | integer | No | Start offset, begins with 0. | | `showAllTopics` | string | No | Whether to show all topics. | | `sort` | string | No | Sorting criteria. | | `timeInterval` | string | No | Publish time interval filter. | | `vertical` | string | No | Result type filter. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "dm_a1_suppress=0;dm_hot_pin=1;d_new_search_h2=0;sb_slot_time=2;sb_sku_rel=1;dm_a…", "data": [ { "highlight": {}, "hit_labels": null, "id": "0ea2cc3a-3048-402e-a710-5ab9e5fae076", "index": 0, "object": { "attached_info_bytes": "Os0BEiBjOGEzZWNhYjIzNmE4Mjc2ZGJmZGE0MmVmMTczODFiNxh6Sgzkurrlt6Xmmbrog71QAFgBYAFq…", "major_info": { "avg_salary": 0, "classification": "工学", "degree": [ "工学学士" ], "discussions": { "contents": [ { "has_more": false, "id": "experience", "items": [ { "highlight": { "description": "985及以上可以去，这是一个赢者通吃很看能力的专业。985以下慎重，一堆线性代数都教不清楚的学校，开设了一堆名叫“人工智能”的专业罢了。", "title": "人工智能专业前景怎么样？" }, "hit_labels": null, "object": { "answer_count": 43, "answer_type": "normal", "attached_info_bytes": "OpkCCgtwbGFjZWhvbGRlchIgYzhhM2VjYWIyMzZhODI3NmRiZmRhNDJlZjE3MzgxYjcYBCIJNzY0MzUz…", "author": { "authority_info": null, "avatar_url": "https://pica.zhimg.com/50/v2-687e9d0a8ef814155e9c326283d50b68_l.jpg?source=4e949…", "badge": [], "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "" }, "badge_v2_string": "{\"title\":\"\",\"merged_badges\":[],\"detail_badges\":null,\"icon\":\"\",\"night_icon\":\"\"}", "follower_count": 5, "gender": 1, "headline": "万物有灵。" }, "biz_encoded_params": "sw%3D%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD", "comment_count": 4, "content": "

985及以上可以去，这是一个赢者通吃很看能力的专业。985以下慎重，一堆线性代数都教不清楚的学校，开设了一堆名叫“…", "created_time": 1767749630 }, "type": "search_result" } ], "name": "就读体验" } ], "default_tab_id": "experience" }, "genre": [ "本科" ], "id": "0ea2cc3a-3048-402e-a710-5ab9e5fae076", "name": "人工智能", "top_area": "" }, "type": "major" }, "type": "gaokao" } ], "domain_info": { "first_category": "科技" }, "filter_items": null, "hit_labels": null, "is_brand_word": false, "is_koc_words": false, "item_in_view": [ { "index": 5, "token": "f789e8e4…", "type": "user_survey" } ], "paging": { "is_end": false, "next": "https://api.zhihu.com/search_v3?advert_count=0&correction=1&filter_fields=&gk_ve…" }, "pendant": null, "related_search_result": [], "search_action_info": { "attached_info_bytes": "OrABEiBjOGEzZWNhYjIzNmE4Mjc2ZGJmZGE0MmVmMTczODFiN0oM5Lq65bel5pm66IO9UABYAWABagzk…", "isfeed": false, "lc_idx": 20, "search_hash_id": "c8a3ecab236a8276dbfda42ef17381b7" } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id` | Unique ID of the search result entry. | | `data[].index` | Position of the entry in the result list, starting at 0. | | `data[].object.major_info.classification / data[].object.major_info.degree[]` | Subject category and degree name of a university major card, for example `工学` and `工学学士`. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].name` | Name of a discussion group inside a major card, such as `就读体验` or `就业前景`. The `id` key in the same object holds a short label like `experience`, `future` or `hot`. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].highlight.title` | Question title with the matched keyword wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].highlight.description` | Text snippet from the answer or question with matched keywords wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].object.answer_count / data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].object.comment_count` | Number of answers and number of comments on the item. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].object.content` | Answer body as an HTML string. Some responses cut it short. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].object.created_time` | Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].object.author.follower_count / data[].object.major_info.discussions.contents[].items[].object.author.headline` | Follower count and profile headline of the author. | ## Notes - Use `offset` to page through results. It starts at 0. - Set `vertical` to `answer`, `article` or `zvideo` to limit the result type. Set `sort` to `upvoted_count` or `created_time` to change the order. - Results can differ in shape, so check `type` and the keys inside `object` before you read fields. The sample response shows a major card with grouped discussions. - To read a full answer, call [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail). To search only articles, use [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3). ## Pricing $0.028571 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
